About the Doctor

Committed to Listening First,
Treating Second

The most important role I play as your doctor is figuring out what is going on with your injury. Spending the time to listen to your complaints, physically examining the injury in detail, formulating a diagnosis — and only then laying out a plan to treat the problem — is what I do best.

Dr. Cheng is a Certified Chiropractic Sports Physician (CCSP) and Qualified Medical Evaluator (QME), serving patients in the South Bay Area for over 30 years. He speaks English, Spanish, and Taiwanese.

Doctor of Chiropractic — Palmer College of Chiropractic West
Certified Chiropractic Sports Physician (CCSP)
Qualified Medical Evaluator (QME)
Certified by National Board of Chiropractic Examiners
17+ Years in Chiropractic Sports Medicine
Physical Examinations: High School, College, DMV, Employment

Our Services

Comprehensive
Diagnosis & Treatment

Every patient receives a thorough first visit — approximately 1 hour 15 minutes — so Dr. Cheng can fully understand your condition before recommending a treatment plan.

01
Chiropractic Adjustment
Precise spinal manipulation to restore proper alignment, reduce pain, and improve joint mobility and function.
02
Sports Medicine & Injury Rehab
Specialized care for athletic injuries — from high school athletes to adults — including extremity adjustments and soft tissue work.
03
MRI Referrals & Prescription
We use the most powerful 3 Tesla closed MRI machines. Radiology report included. $300/study for Dr. Cheng's patients.
04
Physical Examinations
High school, college, DMV-intrastate, and employment physical exams available.
05
Auto Accident Care
Medical benefit payments accepted from CSAA, GEICO, State Farm, Farmers, Allstate, Progressive, and more.
06
Urgent Care & Walk-Ins
Same-day appointments available. Call ahead to let us know you're coming: (650) 737-7667.
